# fheENV

> Zero-trust secrets management powered by Fully Homomorphic Encryption. Your .env, encrypted. Not even us.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://www.fheenv.com/docs): Zero-trust secrets management powered by Fully Homomorphic Encryption
- [Getting Started](https://www.fheenv.com/docs/getting-started): Install fheENV and push your first secret in under 2 minutes
- [Installation](https://www.fheenv.com/docs/cli/install): Install the fheENV CLI on macOS, Linux, or Windows
- [CLI Commands](https://www.fheenv.com/docs/cli/commands): Secure credential, signer, project, and environment workflows
- [CI/CD Integration](https://www.fheenv.com/docs/cli/ci-cd): Use workload identity and organization-managed signing in automation
- [Dashboard Overview](https://www.fheenv.com/docs/dashboard/overview): Create projects and inspect public on-chain evidence

## Architecture

- [Architecture Overview](https://www.fheenv.com/docs/architecture/overview): Technical deep-dive into how fheENV works end-to-end
- [Smart Contract](https://www.fheenv.com/docs/architecture/smart-contract): UUPS registry, authorization, FHE storage, and deployment boundary
- [Encryption Flow](https://www.fheenv.com/docs/architecture/encryption-flow): Step-by-step walkthrough of the cryptographic operations in fheENV
- [Security Model](https://www.fheenv.com/docs/architecture/security-model): Threat model, custody boundaries, and operational limits
